title: SpaceX’s $194 billion share unlock exposes a major risk in Aave’s tokenized stock ambitions
summary: About 1.3 billion SpaceX shares become eligible for sale on Oct. 22, worth roughly $194.3 billion at the Oct. 20 close of $147.89. A week earlier, Aave Labs proposed accepting tokenized SpaceX shares (SPCXc) as collateral on its V4 Equities Hub on Base.
